system_name: TTA 4x H100 NVL with ExaStor-MT parallel filesystem
host_processor_caches: L1d 4.5 MiB (96 instances), L1i 3 MiB (96 instances), L2 192 MiB (96 instances), L3 520 MiB (2 instances)
host_storage_type: ExaStor-MT parallel filesystem: Lustre 2.15.8 on ZFS 2.3.5 (NVMe), 1x MDT + 2x OST; local NVMe and SAS
host_storage_capacity: 5.6 TB Lustre (2x 2.8 TB OST) + 2.9 TB MDT + 5.0 TB local ext4 + 2.6 TB /home
host_networking: Intel X710 10GBASE-T + Intel 82599ES 10G SFP+ + Mellanox ConnectX-6 (MT28908, unused)
host_networking_topology: Single-node; 10 GbE Ethernet (ens4f1) carries the Lustre LNet tcp network
accelerator_on-chip_memories: 256 KB L1/shared per SM, 50 MB L2
accelerator_interconnect: NVLink Bridge (NV12, ~212 GB/s busbw per pair) + PCIe Gen5 x16
accelerator_interconnect_topology: Two independent 2-GPU NVLink Bridge pairs (GPU0-GPU1, GPU2-GPU3); cross-pair traffic traverses PCIe/UPI
hw_notes: ASUS ESC8000-E11 (motherboard Z13PG-D32 Series, BIOS 2803). Four H100 NVL in two NVLink Bridge pairs: nvidia-smi nvlink -s reports 12 active links per GPU at 26.562 GB/s each (~212 GB/s busbw per pair). nvidia-smi topo -m shows NV12 for GPU0-GPU1 and GPU2-GPU3, SYS across pairs. GPU0/1 are NUMA-local to node 2 (cores 48-71), GPU2/3 to node 3 (cores 72-95). Training storage is a single-node ExaStor-MT parallel filesystem (Lustre on ZFS) whose MDS/OSS run on this same host.
operating_system: Rocky Linux 10.2 (Red Quartz), kernel 6.12.0-211.16.1.el10_2.0.1.x86_64 (host) / Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS (container)
sw_notes: MLPerf Training v6.1 llama3.1 8B, Closed division with Power. BF16 precision, global batch size 32, LR 1e-3, warmup 511 steps (16348 samples), gradient_accumulation_steps 16, micro batch size 1. Parallelism TP=2, PP=1, CP=1, EP=1 with DP=2, so each TP group stays inside one physical NVLink Bridge pair. 10 independent convergence runs chained via SLURM afterany dependency. Power measured with IPMI DCMI instantaneous readings at 1 s, post-processed with the official mlperf-logging power tools (conversion coefficient 0.94, 80 PLUS Titanium PSU). Training data is served from an ExaStor-MT parallel filesystem (Lustre 2.15.8 on ZFS 2.3.5), 1x MDT + 2x OST on NVMe, with the MDS/OSS running on the same node.
